verdict.rationale: Bolt's official docs repeatedly confirm a built-in Code view where developers can directly edit generated source code, free of token cost, alongside chat-based prompting. Community feedback corroborates active use of code inspection/editing as a workflow tactic (bolt-comm-10). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the code editor's UX/robustness and any IDE-parity details (e.g., syntax highlighting, multi-file navigation specifics).
